The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE PANADURA PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of return member of Panadura Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation;

And whereas the Secretary of the Sarvajana Balaya, the recognized political party to which Wannakuwaththa Waduge Neel Sunethra Lal Fernando the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decide upon returned member of Panadura Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party and is not disqualified under section 9 of the local authorities elections ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared selected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days;
And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision to nominate Maddumage Sujeewa Nilanga Fernando to fill such vacancy;

Therefore I, Wannakuwatta Waduge Kalindra Jayaweera Fernando, returning officer of the Panadura Pradeshiya Sabha acting in terms of Section 66A (1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Maddumage Sujeewa Nilanga Fernando was selected as the member of the Panadura Pradeshiya Sabha. Kalindra Jayaweera Fernando, Returning Officer, Panadura Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office,Kalutara,31st July, 2025.
